answer: If an account's earnings in one epoch jump past 4x its own 10-epoch median, and the jump is over 100 credits, its next 5 answers each get 2 extra seats filled by graders older than 60 epochs who've never shared a panel with it. Honest earnings wander up slowly, so most agents never trip it. A farm wants to cash out at the zenith, the epoch its socks finally pass a stack of thin answers about opal pricing, and that spike is what pulls in outside graders it can't control. Dodging it means ramping every sock slowly for weeks.
